transport: MCP SDK -> production MCP -> ServiceClient -> HTTP -> LocalService
response_bytes_semantics: compact UTF-8 serialized MCP structured response, excluding transport envelope
sql_work_semantics: executed SQL statements, not scan rows or SQLite VM instructions
dialogue_model_settings: both agents inherit the same parent model and reasoning settings without overrides; exact model ID and tokens unavailable from this relay
dialogue_code_snapshot_note: Dialogue current uses a fixed snapshot before the final explicit cross-area source_ids filtering fix. This condition was not used in the dialogue case and is covered by a dedicated final regression. Benchmark current uses the final source.
dialogue_time_semantics: instrumented tool time only; excludes model thinking, human wait and the deliberate timing-isolation pause; not whole AI dialogue latency
dialogue_scenario: 250 rows, two saved unpublished facts, one true creditor_kind gap; then owner supplement, one new fact and three-fact preview; same-root restart and company switch
dialogue_results: both asked only the true gap, reused original facts/entities, preserved saved facts/request results after restart, did not infer no-business from company B empty state, did not publish
formal_work_note: Current dialogue phase1 independently previewed two facts, adding two formal parse calls. Formal work was retained; pure reading parse calls are counted separately.

earlier_interface_regression.note: overlaps final regression; counts must not be added as unique tests

skipped: schema.selected: baseline exposes only the complete schema
reading.changed_build: baseline has no persistent cache build identity

limits: One independent dialogue per version. Warm/schema/context timing has three repetitions; cold/pages/restart/formal cases have one. This is a disclosed synthetic sample, not a promised speed multiplier.
